findings.evidence: Ask first only when the answer would change the shortlist: a non-English target language, a hard budget, or a word that must appear or must not.
findings.fix: Move the three ask-first triggers into Procedure step 1 as the filter questions, and leave Defaults as the assumption line only; record the move in docs/audit/recovery/domain-name-brainstormer/record.md.

findings.evidence: Not for DNS, email, hosting or transfers on a domain already owned, naming without domains, social handles, or legal trademark clearance.
findings.fix: Brainstorm, screen and rank brandable domain names (.com, .io, .app, .dev and other TLDs) for apps, products, companies and personal brands, and report registration status honestly via RDAP/WHOIS lookups. Use when naming a project, launching or rebranding, asking "is this domain available", or replacing a taken first choice, even if the user only describes the business. Not for DNS, email, hosting or transfers on a domain already owned, naming without domains, social handles, or legal trademark clearance. Also use when the user pastes RDAP or WHOIS output, asks which shortlisted names can be bought, or wants a sample shortlist.
